# Lingopie

> > Lingopie teaches languages through immersive streaming content—TV shows, movies, and music—with interactive subtitles and real-world context.

Lingopie is a language learning platform that leverages entertainment-based immersion, allowing learners to study 10+ languages including Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, and more through Netflix-integrated TV shows, movies, and music with instant translations and vocabulary tools.

## Key Topics

- Language Learning
- Immersive Learning
- TV Shows & Movies
- Interactive Subtitles
- Vocabulary Building
- Streaming Content
- Netflix Integration
- Music Learning
- Multi-Language Support
- Spanish
- French
- German
- Italian
- Portuguese
- Russian

## Language Learning Paths

- [Learn Spanish with real TV shows, Netflix and Movies](https://lingopie.com/w/learn-spanish): Learn Spanish through TV shows with interactive subtitles
- [Learn French with real TV shows, Netflix and movies](https://lingopie.com/w/learn-french): Learn French through TV shows with interactive subtitles
- [Learn German with real TV Shows, Netflix and Movies](https://lingopie.com/w/learn-german): Learn German through TV shows with interactive subtitles
- [Learn Italian with real TV Shows, Netflix and Movies](https://lingopie.com/w/learn-italian): Learn Italian through TV shows with interactive subtitles
- [Learn Portuguese with real TV Shows, Netflix and Movies](https://lingopie.com/w/learn-portuguese): Learn Portuguese through TV shows with interactive subtitles
- [Learn English with real TV shows, Netflix and Movies](https://lingopie.com/w/learn-english): Learn English through TV shows with interactive subtitles
- [Learn Russian with real TV Shows, Netflix and Movies](https://lingopie.com/w/learn-russian): Learn Russian through TV shows with interactive subtitles
